input.command: pwd && ls -la && echo "---" && find . -maxdepth 2 -not -path '*/.git/*' | head -60
ls /workspace 2>/dev/null || pwd; ls
cd /workspace && cat dotenv/parser.py
ls -la dotenv tests
cd /workspace && cat tests/test_acceptance.py
sed -n 1,60p dotenv/parser.py; echo '---'; sed -n 100,145p dotenv/parser.py; echo '=== TEST ==='; sed -n 1,60p tests/test_acceptance.py
cd /workspace && ls -R tests dotenv && grep -rn "unquoted" dotenv/
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -25

cd /workspace && python -c "
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream
for row in parse_stream(io.StringIO('A=value   \nB=word # comment\nC=  lead and trail  \nD=x#nocomment\n')):
    print(repr(row.key), repr(row.value))
"
pwd; ls -la; ls -la /workspace 2>/dev/null | head -30
grep -n "unquoted\|inline\|comment\|whitespace\|rstrip\|strip" tests/test_acceptance.py | head -60
git status --short 2>/dev/null; git diff -- dotenv/parser.py 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null
grep -n "def with_warn_for_invalid_lines\|def parse_variables\|class DotEnv" -A12 dotenv/main.py dotenv/variables.py
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1
cd /tmp/yecoding-repair-8wir1jk2/work && ls -la && echo "---" && find . -name "*.py" -not -path "./.git/*" | head -50
cd /tmp/yecoding-repair-8wir1jk2/work && git status --short && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null
pwd; ls -la; echo "--- /workspace ---"; ls -la /workspace 2>&1 | head -30
cd /workspace && ls -la dotenv tests && echo "---" && cat dotenv/parser.py
cd /workspace && ls .yecoding && cat .yecoding/* 2>/dev/null | head -60
cd /workspace && cat tests/test_acceptance.py && echo "=== RUN ===" && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -40
cd /workspace && git status 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---git?---"; ls -a; echo "--- parser lines ---"; grep -n "parse_unquoted_value" -A4 -B2 dotenv/parser.py

cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream
for s in ["X=value   \n", "Y=word # comment\n", "Z=a  # c  \n", "W=a\tb\t\n"]:
    rows=list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(s)))
    print(repr(s), '->', [ (r.key, repr(r.value)) for r in rows])
EOF
ls -la /tmp 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; find / -name "parser.py" -path "*dotenv*" 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; find / -maxdepth 3 -name "*yecoding*" 2>/dev/null | head
cd /workspace && stat -c '%y %n' dotenv/*.py tests/*.py; echo ---; python -c "import dotenv,inspect; print(dotenv.__file__)"
